topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This topic provides the opening framing, practical review, and stated learning outcomes for the lecture.

topics.label: Viral discovery and experimental assays of cellular transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the historical discovery of tumor viruses, how retroviruses transduce cellular proto-oncogenes, and the laboratory assays used to test transforming activity.

topics.label: Oncogenes, tumor suppressors, and mutational mechanisms in cell cycle control
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the classification and genetic mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes, using key pathways like Rb and p53 to illustrate allele dosage and dominant-negative effects.

topics.label: Mechanisms and cellular consequences of sequence and chromosomal instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defects in specific DNA repair pathways, replication machinery, and mitotic segregation generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression, hereditary cancer syndromes, and tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the stepwise accumulation and inheritance of cancer-predisposing mutations drive tumor development and impact malignant progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This topic contains the concluding administrative framing and reading recommendations for the lecture.
